title: ReH-FUSE: Reliability-Aware Hierarchical Fusion of Experts for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13857v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) requires adapting to the instance-dependent reliability of different evidence sources. Lexical content may be decisive, vocal expression may provide complementary cues, or accurate recognition may require cross-modal interaction; fixed fusion does not explicitly account for this variation. We propose ReH-FUSE, a reliability-aware framework with dialogue-aware text, audio, and cross-modal experts. Its decision-level router first models the relative preference between text and audio and then balances the resulting unimodal mixture against the cross-modal expert. This factorization separates unimodal competition from cross-modal selection. Across three independent runs on IEMOCAP, ReH-FUSE achieves 74.34% weighted F1 and 73.11% macro F1; on MELD, it achieves 68.03% weighted F1. translated_title: ReH-FUSE：面向对话中多模态情感识别的可靠性感知分层专家融合
translated_abstract: 对话中的多模态情感识别（ERC）需要适应不同证据来源随实例而变的可靠性。词汇内容可能是决定性的，语音表达可能提供补充线索，或者准确识别可能需要跨模态交互；而固定的融合方法并未显式地考虑这种变化。我们提出了ReH-FUSE，一个可靠性感知的框架，包含对话感知的文本专家、音频专家和跨模态专家。其决策级路由器首先建模文本与音频之间的相对偏好，然后将得到的单模态混合结果与跨模态专家进行平衡。这种因式分解将单模态之间的竞争与跨模态选择分离开来。在IEMOCAP数据集上的三次独立运行中，ReH-FUSE实现了74.34%的加权F1和73.11%的宏F1；在MELD数据集上，它实现了68.03%的加权F1。受控消融实验表明，学习到的路由机制优于均匀的专家平均，并受益于跨模态专家的参与。
tldr: 提出ReH-FUSE框架，通过可靠性感知的分层专家融合——先由决策级路由器平衡文本与音频专家的相对偏好，再与跨模态专家进行权衡——在IEMOCAP上达到74.34%加权F1、在MELD上达到68.03%加权F1，显著优于均匀专家平均的融合方式。
en_tdlr: ReH-FUSE is a reliability-aware hierarchical mixture-of-experts framework that first routes between text and audio experts and then balances the resulting unimodal mixture against a cross-modal expert, achieving 74.34% weighted F1 on IEMOCAP and 68.03% on MELD for emotion recognition in conversation.
